scientific_question: Does frozen calibration-only Orc Graph selection improve matched heldout error over direct ridge on new independently selected airport observations?
original_publisher: NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center METAR Data API
first_capture_qualifier: source witness complete timestamp, not signed historical publication
availability_for_retrospective_profile: AWC-reported receiptTime <= forecast_origin; not independently authenticated publication
availability_for_strict_profile: observationTime, receiptTime and first-seen captureTime all <= forecast_origin; never interpret as production authority
multiple_reports_in_same_hour: refuse bin as ambiguous; retain all originals and reasons
missing_temperature: refuse bin and count; no forward fill, interpolation, or substitution
missing_hours: retain complete hourly grid with explicit missing counts
late_receipt: feature ineligible if source-reported receipt after origin; retain reason
future_first_capture: strict-profile feature ineligible, never reconstructed from receiptTime
fold_boundaries: target hour must be within same train/cal/test fold; no crossing labels
forecast_origin: UTC end of the origin hour; horizon target is later hour bucket
holdout_target_disclosure_in_R3: no target values, predictions, fitted methods, errors, or rankings in emitted cohort manifests
failure_policy: report every fixed station/horizon with denominator and reason; never silently intersect or replace
